product.title: San Diego eBike Tours on Coronado

description.text: Ride a guided electric bike tour across Coronado Island on flat, car-free paths with views of the Coronado Bridge, Hotel del Coronado, and San Diego Bay. The route follows separated bike lanes through Victorian neighborhoods and the Silver Strand shoreline while your guide shares local history and takes photos along the way.

highlights: Guided Coronado electric bike tour on flat, car-free paths
Ride under the Coronado Bridge and along the Silver Strand
Stop at Hotel del Coronado and Victorian neighborhood viewpoints
Views of San Diego Bay and the downtown skyline
Includes bottled water and guide photography

start.description: Meet your Coronado eBike tour guide wearing a white Scenic Cycle t-shirt and black shorts at the confirmed Coronado meeting point.

itineraryItems.title: Coronado bike paths
itineraryItems.description: Begin on separated bike paths under the Coronado Bridge and through the island toward the Silver Strand.

itineraryItems.title: Hotel del Coronado
itineraryItems.description: Pause at the historic Hotel del Coronado for photos and optional ice cream.

itineraryItems.title: San Diego Bay views
itineraryItems.description: Continue along waterfront bike routes with panoramic views of San Diego Bay.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
Riders must be at least 14 years old
